name: Start Webserver Noauth Architecture
description: Architecture for the make start-webserver-noauth target, covering the nginx-only local static stack, the selected noauth CALM CLI configuration, and the setup helpers that prepare the HTTP endpoint on port 8080.

nodes.name: Architect
nodes.description: A human architect or operator who starts the noauth local stack, follows the host announcement from the startup flow, and requests the repository's static CALM assets over HTTP.

nodes.name: Public Host Detection Helper
nodes.description: The scripts/detect_public_host.py helper that resolves the local host name or IP exported as CALM_PUBLIC_HOST before the noauth nginx container is started.

nodes.name: Active CALM CLI Config Link
nodes.description: The ~/.calm.json symlink that the startup target rewires so local CALM CLI calls point at the configuration required for the noauth stack.

nodes.name: Noauth CALM CLI Config
nodes.description: The ~/.calmnoauth.json configuration file selected by the target so local CALM CLI usage follows the noauth repository endpoint conventions.

nodes.name: Noauth Nginx Config
nodes.description: The infra/nginx/nginx.noauth.conf file mounted into the nginx container to expose the static tree and anonymous /healthz endpoint over HTTP on port 8080.

nodes.name: HTTP Static Content Tree
nodes.description: The static_http content tree mounted directly into nginx so architecture JSON, patterns, standards, controls, and related documentation are served from the local repository.

nodes.name: Nginx Static Web Server
nodes.description: The nginx Compose service started by make start-webserver-noauth, serving the repository's static content over plain HTTP on port 8080 without oauth2-proxy or Keycloak.

nodes.name: Docker Compose
nodes.description: A container grouping representing the docker-compose runtime started by the noauth target.

relationships.description: Architects run the public host detection helper to discover which local host the noauth startup flow will advertise before nginx is started.
The detected CALM_PUBLIC_HOST value informs the nginx startup flow and the host narrative announced for the local HTTP endpoint.
The startup target rewires ~/.calm.json so the active CALM CLI config points at ~/.calmnoauth.json before the noauth web server is started.
The nginx container loads the noauth nginx configuration that exposes repository assets and keeps /healthz anonymously available.
The nginx server serves static repository assets from the mounted static_http content tree.
Architects request the repository's static site and CALM assets from nginx over anonymous HTTP on port 8080, while the /healthz endpoint remains open for operational checks.
The noauth docker-compose startup groups the nginx service together with the mounted static content and nginx configuration used by that service.
